summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing ongoing share repurchases under a buyback program of up to DKK 15 billion over 12 months from February 4, 2026. The filing details daily transactions through June 12, 2026, with an accumulated 19,884,179 B shares repurchased at an average price of DKK 264.99, totaling DKK 5.27 billion. The company holds 0.8% of share capital as treasury shares. This is a routine open-market buyback executed under EU Safe Harbour Rules. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for continued execution pace and potential impact on share price.
